images.scene: A vast vintage 1950s boxing gym seen from behind: an old boxing coach in a flat cap and dark cardigan standing with his back to the camera at MID DISTANCE, small against the huge hall, low in the frame, a wooden clipboard held in one hand at his side with a whistle cord dangling from the same hand, silently facing a single heavy leather punching bag hanging perfectly still from a chain a few steps ahead of him. Worn plank floor stretching in front, tall industrial windows pouring hazy light. The coach and the bag sit in the lower half of the frame, the empty floor foreground filling the bottom of the image and bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above them is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A 1950s training seminar in full swing, seen from behind the audience: rows of wooden folding chairs FILLED with attentive men in shirt sleeves, all leaning forward eagerly taking notes in notebooks, energy and enthusiasm in the room, a bright hazy stage area far ahead, 1950s. All notebook pages completely blank, no readable writing anywhere. The audience fills the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

Rows of empty wooden folding chairs in a plain hall just after a lecture has ended, loose sheets of completely blank paper scattered on the floorboards between the chairs, one chair knocked slightly askew, still dust in the air, 1950s. The chairs fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

The morning after in an empty plain hall: a janitor's wide push broom sweeping a pile of confetti and curled paper streamers across worn floorboards, only the broom and the lower legs of the janitor visible low in the frame, still dust in the pale light, 1950s. The broom and the confetti fill the bottom third of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and completely empty.

A 1950s boxer in mid-training seen from the side, throwing a straight punch into a heavy swinging leather bag, sweat flying off, taped fists, the repeated motion almost mechanical, chalk dust in the air of a worn gym. The boxer and the bag fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above them is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

Seen from a distance in a vast vintage gym: a lean athlete skipping rope, his SMALL full figure low in the frame, the rope a blurred arc of motion, both feet off the worn plank floor in mid-jump, 1950s. The athlete occupies ONLY THE BOTTOM THIRD of the frame, small against the huge empty hall, bleeding off the bottom edge. The entire upper two thirds of the image are bright, pale, hazy and completely empty.

Seen from a slightly elevated angle in a vast vintage gym: an old boxing coach in a flat cap crouched low at the ring corner, talking firmly to his seated young boxer between rounds, pointing one finger, towel over the boxer's shoulder, 1950s. The two crouched men are SMALL and LOW, occupying ONLY THE BOTTOM THIRD of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The entire upper two thirds of the image are bright, pale, hazy and completely empty, with no ropes and no posts rising above the men.

Close view of the weathered hands of an old coach holding an open small notebook with completely blank pages, a pencil tucked against the spine, worn gym softly blurred behind, 1950s. The pages are completely blank with no writing of any kind. The hands and the notebook fill the bottom third of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A young 1950s boxer doing push-ups on the worn plank floor of a vintage gym, mid-repetition, sweat dripping, while his old coach in a flat cap crouches beside him pointing firmly at the floor demanding one more, morning light, 1950s. The two men are LOW in the frame, filling only the bottom third, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above them is bright, pale, hazy and completely empty.

A 1950s boxing coach standing at the ring apron holding a stopwatch in one hand and striking a small brass ring bell with the other, while a tired young boxer walks back to the center of the ring one more time, seen from behind. The coach, the bell and the boxer sit in the MIDDLE of the frame, with a generous empty foreground of dark ring apron and worn plank floor boards filling the ENTIRE bottom third of the image and bleeding off the bottom edge. No crowd in the foreground. The space above them is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A row of worn leather boxing gloves hanging from iron hooks on a wooden rail on the plank wall of a vintage gym, each pair cracked and stitched from years of daily use, faint chalk smudges on the wood, no people, 1950s. The gloves and the rail sit in the MIDDLE of the frame, the weathered plank wall continuing below them and filling the ENTIRE bottom third of the image, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

First morning light flooding through tall industrial windows into an otherwise empty vintage gym: an old coach steadying the heavy bag with both hands while a young boxer trains against it, long shadows across the plank floor, 1950s. The two figures fill the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above them is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A large 1950s training hall with a team of boxers shadowboxing in staggered rows, all frozen in the same stance at the same instant, their old coach walking between the rows watching them, slight diagonal view. The team fills the bottom half of the frame, bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above them is bright, pale, hazy and empty.

A broad-shouldered old coach seen from BEHIND in the immediate foreground, arms crossed, flat cap, watching his full gym at work: boxers hitting bags, skipping rope and sparring in the ring, all in soft pale haze. The coach's dark figure is LARGE, filling the bottom half of the frame and bleeding off the bottom edge. The space above him is bright, pale, hazy and empty.
